debit.notes: 24/7 phone banking on toll-free 18002665555 / 1800229999 lists Card Hotlisting among its services. Separately, a 24-hour Help Desk for Visa Debit Card/Internet Banking/Mobile Banking queries answers 022 41572070 / 022 69933333 and reads customersupport@saraswatbank.com / customerservicecentre@saraswatbank.com.
